title: just-deliver catalog policy
description: IT Ops layer. 'set' overrides any other layer, 'default' only fills gaps, 'add' adds nodes. At least one of the three is required. Unique by name across the catalog.

reason.description: Why the policy exists; shown to teams asking why a setting has its value.

match.description: Criteria the policy applies to: the mapping criteria plus 'template' (the template of a node).

set.description: Config path -> value. Wins over every other layer.

default.description: Config path -> value, applied only where nothing else set the field.

add.description: Nodes added to the graph, by name.

template.description: Template reference, relative to the catalog's templates directory.

kind.description: create (default) or grant. Grants are surfaced in the approval diff.

config.description: Template configuration. Values are any YAML scalar or map, kept as written.
